name: Put Your Back Into It!
description:
**Perk**

During montage tests, whenever you make a test to assist a test and obtain a tier 1 outcome, you don't add a bane to the assisted test. Additionally, once per montage test, you can turn an ally's tier 1 test outcome into a tier 2 outcome.
